projection.frame: Mean Earth / polar axis of DE421

source.name: NASA LRO / LOLA — South polar elevation map
source.processing: 160 x 160 source-pixel crop; 2 x 2 arithmetic averaging to an 80 x 80 grid. Elevation = signed little-endian int16 DN x 0.5 m, relative to a 1737400 m sphere. No synthetic elevations added.
